  @⁨Kirsten Ritschel⁩ wanted to check with you 
  
  1. For the chocolate corvetue you are getting from Connexion how long is the shelf life?

  The premium dark chocolate bars you have produced from cacao nibs is very exciting by the way. 😊🙏

  2. figure out the shelf life of the dark chocolate corvetue
  
  3. ⁠figure out the cost of producing the corvetue in Bahia Brazil so as to minimize the production effort of producing premium dark chocolate bars in San Francisco USA

  Corvetue are giant chocolate blocks that suppliers supply wholesale directly to chocolatiers which that can cut out sections of to make chocolate with. 
  
  It is different from the completed chocolate bars of which pricing information you obtained from our manufacturers (_Santos, Martinus_) in Brazil.
